definitions.explanation: Sake served chilled, typically refrigerated rather than at room temperature. Many premium sakes are best enjoyed cold to bring out subtle flavors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷酒|れいしゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい。
examples.english: Cold sake tastes great in summer.

examples.japanese: {冷酒|れいしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一杯|いっぱい}→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: One glass of cold sake, please.

examples.japanese: ⟦{吟醸酒|ぎんじょうしゅ}→吟醸酒：22247_ginjoushu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冷酒|れいしゅ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧わかる。
examples.english: When you drink ginjo sake chilled, you can really appreciate its aroma.

notes:
Compound of {冷|れい} (cold) + {酒|しゅ} (sake). Refers specifically to sake served cold, in contrast to ⟦{熱燗|あつかん}→熱燗：27548_atsukan⟧ (hot sake) or ⟦{常温|じょうおん}→常温：14722_jouon⟧ (room temperature).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷酒|れいしゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to order cold sake
- ⟦{冷|ひ}えた→冷える：01154_hieru⟧{冷酒|れいしゅ}: well-chilled sake
- {冷酒|れいしゅ}⟦グラス→グラス：00076_gurasu⟧: cold sake glass

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{熱燗|あつかん}→熱燗：27548_atsukan⟧: hot sake (warmed)
- ⟦{常温|じょうおん}→常温：14722_jouon⟧: room temperature (sake)
- ⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧: sake (general term)
- ⟦{冷|ひ}や→冷や：28141_hiya⟧: cold/cool — older term, sometimes refers to room-temperature sake in traditional contexts
